To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the field of animal-based biomedical research has entered a period of crisis.

the reproducibility crisis in animal-based biomedical research is a result of the failure of researchers to consider how the animal research model differs from human patients, and that the field of therioepistemologic research is a nascent discipline that is beginning to formalize the study of this phenomenon.

understanding and improving the quality of animal research.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
therioepistemologic research should be a required part of all animal-based biomedical research.
Therioepistemological research is the study of how to best use animals in biomedical research.

therioepistemologic thinking is a new paradigm for the study of animal research, one that can help to improve the reproducability and translatability in animal-based biomedical research, with benefits for animal well-being and human health.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
therioepistemologists are interested in how animals are used in biomedical research, not whether they are.
therioepistemologists are not against the use of animals in biomedical research, we are just for the best possible use of animals in research.
therioepistemologically sound research will be reproducible, and will be more likely to lead to translational outcomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

therioepistemologic considerations should be incorporated into all aspects of biomedical research, and that therioepistemic considerations should be a central part of all preclinical research planning.

therioepistemologists need to work together to develop a common language and framework for evaluating and critiquing animal-based research, and we hope this paper serves as a first step in that direction.
